name: Deployment Flowchart
description: Process chain across role lanes — makes hand-offs visible
whenToUse: When an existing chain needs to show which role owns which step and where the hand-offs are — not for capturing a new process without a role assignment yet.
laneHint: New steps land in “Unassigned” — drag them by their number onto a role band (keyboard: Enter, then ↑/↓) to assign them.
emptyHint: No roles yet — add a role from the toolbar, then add steps.
insertHere: Insert here — or drop a card here to move it
importHint: Pick a source. Its steps are appended to the end of the chain and start out in “Unassigned”.
importEmptyHint: No matching source (SIPOC / Process Map) found in this project.
importFailed: Import failed: the source is no longer available.

invariants.uniqueStepIds: Every step needs its own id.
invariants.uniqueSubstepIds: Every sub-step needs its own id within its step.
invariants.uniqueLaneIds: Every lane needs its own id.
invariants.reservedLane: The “Unassigned” lane carries no name of its own; its label comes from the interface.
invariants.knownLanes: Every step lies in an existing lane.
invariants.validExpanded: Only existing steps can be expanded.
